name: Crispy Air-Fryer Broccoli

ingredients.name: broccoli florets, cut into 1 1/2 to 2-inch pieces

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a 6-quart air fryer to 205°C (400°F) (205ºC) for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, toss broccoli with oil, salt, and pepper and toss to evenly coat. Pour broccoli into air fryer basket and cook until broccoli is still bright green but starting to char around edges, about 5 minutes. Remove basket from air fryer and shake to toss broccoli florets. Return to air fryer and decrease temperature to 171°C (170ºC). Cook until broccoli is crisp-tender, about 3 more minutes. Remove and transfer broccoli to a serving platter or plates.

schema_metadata.keywords: air fryer broccoli, broccoli in air fryer, broccoli air fryer, air fryer broccoli recipe

description: Air-frying broccoli isn’t complicated, but there are a few tricks that’ll help you make it truly superb. Make perfectly crisp broccoli with our basic recipe—and dress it up with our five easy, delicious variations.
notes:
Make-ahead and storage: Broccoli crowns can be chopped into florets and refrigerated in a zip-top bag or airtight container up to 3 days before cooking.
Air-fried broccoli can be made up to 4 days in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container. Reheat in a microwave or air fryer preheated to 340ºF (170ºC) until warm.
author: Genevieve Yam
